material.learn: A breakdown that climbs back inside its range traps sellers.

against.head: A lower high and a lower low
against.text: Its last swing high and swing low each came in under the one before.
against.learn: Falling swing highs and lows are the steps of a downtrend.

against.head: The trigger failed before
against.text: It closed above this line once since Oct 8 and gave it back .
against.learn: A line price closed above and then gave back has failed once already; the next break has to hold to count.

against.head: Resistance +1.8% above
against.text: The nearest ceiling is +1.8% above (0.4 ATR), where 8 levels (4 kinds) meet: the Oct 1 low, the 200-day average and the average price paid since the Oct 16 high: little room before sellers have stepped in before.
against.learn: A ceiling: sellers stepped in there before.

material.head: Weekly: wave 4 in its buy zone
material.text: Waves 1 to 3 up from Aug 4, 2025 to May 4 (+166%; wave 3 is 3.8 times wave 1). The pullback has reached the 0.382–0.5 zone of wave 3 (+1.8% to −6.7%), in three waves, on lighter volume, with the 50-week average and the Aug 10 low in the same place. The count is wrong on a close under the wave-1 high (−32%): wave 4 never overlaps wave 1.
material.learn: Wave 4 usually pulls back to the 0.382–0.5 retracement of wave 3 and holds above wave 1's top; the buy comes when price turns up there.

material.head: In a 9-week base
material.text: It has moved sideways for 9 weeks in a range 24% deep after a +27% advance.
material.learn: A sideways range after a move, where the stock rests before its next leg.
